title: IntakePayload v1
description: Canonical intake payload schema for POST /api/public/intake. Source of truth: tally-form-spec.json (webhook_payload_schema, v1.0.0). This schema is the single source of truth — backend Zod schema and frontend wizard must conform to it. Any change to this contract is a migration event requiring version bump + CEO approval.

business_name.description: Trading / display name of the business. Required.

sector.description: Business vertical. Must match one of the 6 Tally options exactly.

short_description.description: One-line description of the chatbot's role. Required.

website_url.description: Business website URL (optional). Must be a valid URI if provided.

logo_upload.description: URL of the business logo image (optional).

pronoun.description: Pronoun / formality register for the chatbot. Required.

language.description: Languages the chatbot should speak. At least one required.

forbidden_words.description: Comma-separated list of words the chatbot must never use (optional).

business_hours_weekday.description: Weekday hours as free text, e.g. 'L-V 9:00–14:00 / 16:00–20:00'. Required.

business_hours_weekend.description: Weekend hours as free text, e.g. 'Sáb 10:00–14:00'. Required.

holidays_url_or_text.description: Holiday schedule as URL or free text (optional).

out_of_hours_behavior.description: What the chatbot should do outside business hours. Required.

faqs.description: List of FAQ Q&A pairs. Keys must be 'q' and 'a' (not 'question'/'answer'). 10–15 items required.

channels_enabled.description: Enabled communication channels. At least one required. Values: 'web' | 'whatsapp' | 'instagram'.

whatsapp_business_number.description: WhatsApp Business number in E.164 format (e.g. +34612345678). Required when 'whatsapp' is in channels_enabled. Must not include spaces or leading zeros.

whatsapp_business_verified.description: Whether the WhatsApp number is verified in Meta Business Manager. Required when 'whatsapp' is in channels_enabled.

instagram_handle.description: Instagram handle (without @). Required when 'instagram' is in channels_enabled.

web_install_target.description: Target platform for the web chat widget install. Optional but recommended when 'web' is in channels_enabled.

human_handoff_email.description: Email address for human handoff when chatbot can't resolve a query. Required.

human_handoff_whatsapp.description: WhatsApp number for human escalation in E.164 format (optional).

human_handoff_hours.description: Hours when a human is available to take escalations. Required.

escalation_triggers.description: Description of what situations should trigger a human escalation. Required.

gdpr_responsible_email.description: Email of the person responsible for GDPR compliance at the business. Required.

privacy_url.description: URL of the business's privacy policy / GDPR notice. Required.

cross_field_rules.description: When 'whatsapp' is in channels_enabled, whatsapp_business_number (E.164) and whatsapp_business_verified are required.
When 'instagram' is in channels_enabled, instagram_handle is required.
